scientific_integrity: Uniform analytic proof with reproducible auxiliary exact-arithmetic finite checks. Finite tests are not substitutes for proof. No independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Only K_{a,a,b} with integers a>=3 and b>=2, equal first two parts; strictly separates real L1 only below b=4a-3 and does not compute its exact subcritical constant. Older equivalent formulations remain a bibliographic risk.
title: A sharp metric-to-\(L^1\) Poincaré transition on unbalanced complete tripartite graphs
